query: Alice Springs Australia taxi Uber fare per km base fare 2026
source: taxi-fare.com.au / NT Government CPV schedule (Alice Springs Taxi Fare Calculator 2026)
snippet: NT-regulated Alice Springs taxi rates: weekday daytime per-km rate $2.39, night/weekend/public-holiday per-km rate $2.82. Flagfall (base fare) is A$5.30. A typical 5km trip costs about A$18, a 12km cross-town run about A$35. As of 2026 neither Uber nor DiDi operates in Alice Springs; rideshare in the NT runs only in Darwin. Rates current as of May 22, 2026, regulated by NT Department of Logistics and Infrastructure.
